name: Hello Box
tagline: Admin panel for a Telegram-bot shop: products, partners, news
role: Admin dashboard by the Softwhere team for a Telegram-bot shop

scenes.title: One panel behind the shop's bot
scenes.body: Operators manage what the Hellobox Telegram bot sells from a single neumorphic React panel.

scenes.title: Product catalog at a glance
scenes.body: Each item lists its price, category and expiry window, with edit and delete actions on every row.

scenes.title: Add a product in one form
scenes.body: Upload a photo, pick a category and partner shop, then set price, expiry and profit share.

scenes.title: News posts for the bot
scenes.body: Write a post and attach an uploaded image, ready to go out through the bot.
